html:
/* Hover tooltip of {{Item}}: the item card opens beside the icon and name (tip=left: on the left side) */
.aa-itemtip {
  position: relative;
}
.aa-itemtip-card {
  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  top: -8px;
  left: 100%;
  z-index: 200;
  padding-left: 6px;   /* no gap, so the card stays open while the pointer moves onto it */
  width: 300px;
  max-width: 90vw;
  white-space: normal;
  font-weight: normal;
  font-style: normal;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: default;
}
.aa-itemtip-left .aa-itemtip-card {
  left: auto;
  right: 100%;
  padding-left: 0;
  padding-right: 6px;
}
.aa-itemtip:hover .aa-itemtip-card {
  display: block;
}
.aa-itemtip-card .aa-item {
  margin: 0;
}
/* Phones: no room beside the item, the card opens below it */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .aa-itemtip-card,
  .aa-itemtip-left .aa-itemtip-card {
    top: 100%;
    left: 0;
    right: auto;
    padding: 4px 0 0;
  }
}

/* ===== THEME COLOURS (dark + light) ===== */
/* Colours for the wiki's two themes. Light: wiki set to Day, or Auto with a light browser. Dark: Night, or Auto with a dark browser. */
/* LIGHT */
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .aa-item { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #fffaf0, #f5ecdb); border-color: #c9b998; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(80, 55, 25, .22); color: #3a2f26; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .aa-item span[style*="color"] { filter: brightness(.62) saturate(1.25); }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .aa-itemtip > :not(.aa-itemtip-card) [style*="color"],
html.skin-theme-clientpref-day .aa-itemtip > [style*="color"]:not(.aa-itemtip-card) { filter: brightness(.62) saturate(1.25); }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-item { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #fffaf0, #f5ecdb); border-color: #c9b998; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(80, 55, 25, .22); color: #3a2f26; }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-item span[style*="color"] { filter: brightness(.62) saturate(1.25); }
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-itemtip > :not(.aa-itemtip-card) [style*="color"],
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-itemtip > [style*="color"]:not(.aa-itemtip-card) { filter: brightness(.62) saturate(1.25); }
}
/* DARK */
html.skin-theme-clientpref-night .aa-item { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(46, 38, 32, .98), rgba(27, 21, 17, .98)); border-color: #6a5340; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55), 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, .6); color: #e8e1d6; }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
html.skin-theme-clientpref-os .aa-item { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(46, 38, 32, .98), rgba(27, 21, 17, .98)); border-color: #6a5340; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55), 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, .6); color: #e8e1d6; }
}
